title: Futures book account size at an MFFU-type swing firm (50k / 100k / 150k), nested sizing

terms (ASSUMED from third-party summarie.50k: target 3k (6%), EOD trailing 2k (4%) locking at start, fee $150

common: 90% split, payouts every 14 days, no daily limit; consistency rule not modelled
book: results/book_corrected_p1.parquet (current futures book), scaled to 15% vol with the 2010-22 sd
selection: per size: max 2010-22 bootstrap mean net with P(profit) >= 0.90; then the size with the highest 2010-22 mean net
evaluation: 2023-26 bootstrap (and the halved-mean stress) for all three sizes at their chosen settings
